entries.source: Regesten der Pfalzgrafen am Rhein 1214 - 1508: Karlsr. Coph. 464,156v. — Gegenbrief d. d. juli 24. Or. Karlsr. G. L. A. — Vgl. Widder I,421.
entries.german: Ruprecht verpfändet Conrad von Rosenberg, vitztum zu Heidelberg, das haus Minneberg, als es Ulrich Landschad inne gehabt hat, für 810 florentiner gulden.
entries.english: Ruprecht pledges to Conrad von Rosenberg, Viztame at Heidelberg, the Minneberg house, as Ulrich Landschad had held it, for 810 Florentine guilders.
facts: Konrad von Rosenberg is titled Vitzthum zu Heidelberg
Ruprecht pledged the house Minneberg to Konrad von Rosenberg
Konrad von Rosenberg received the house Minneberg which had previously been held by Ulrich Landschad
Konrad von Rosenberg participated in significant property transactions with Ruprecht
